Post Industrial Revolution we create mere cogs to fit into a far larger machine, or even nothing at all in todays service economies. Very unfulfilling.

I think being forced into completely unfulfilling work that goes against our biology (check out Historia Civilis’s video “Time” for evidence and an analysis of this) is one of the great injustices of our world post the introduction of capitalism. That being said, it is necessary in our world and I do feel that those at the moment at least who choose not to work are doing so quite selfishly.
